hypothesis: The LookupTranslator uses a HashMap to store lookup keys. When the input is a CharSequence (like StringBuffer), the lookup fails because the keys in the map (which are likely Strings) do not equal the input CharSequence, as CharSequence implementations do not guarantee consistent equals/hashCode behavior. The fix requires normalizing the input or the map keys to a common type (like String) to ensure correct lookup.
